title: Return Removed Splashes
description: The resource pack adds to the list of all possible splashes (JE) the splashes that were removed from the game, such as "The Work of Notch!", "Half price!", "Check it out!", and others.
body:
The resource pack adds to the list of all possible splashes (JE) the splashes that were removed from the game, such as "The Work of Notch!", "Half price!", "Check it out!", and others listed below.
